decided: Under one pull request per program, when a signed program has a newer brief, the architect session skips the new question only when the pull request check positively shows nothing is left to mark ready: the pull request is ready; or no program pull request was ever recorded for the doc at all; or none is open; or the recorded one is no longer the program's open pull request (closed, merged, pointed at another branch, or from another repository) and no open replacement exists. When a pull request was recorded without its link and the check fails, when the check cannot reach GitHub or finds several candidate pull requests, or when it reports a draft, the user is asked again.
alternatives: ask again only on a draft or unverified state, which skips the question when the check fails with no recorded link or finds several candidates
why: A question that holds the ready step should never be skipped because the state could not be read; skipping it is only safe when the state is known.

relies_on.title: `orbit pr program` computes the architect readout's PR facts
